verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a workstation GPU, and controlling data retention and deletion is a privacy axis for services that store user data, not for a local hardware accelerator. The evidence only notes that AI can run locally and securely (docs-1, docs-10), which describes where workloads run rather than any retention or deletion control. Nothing shows the product itself ships such a capability, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
